summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K announcing a purchase of 8,000,000 of its own ordinary shares on 14 May 2026, executed through Goldman Sachs International. The volume-weighted average price was 96.0286 pence per share. The buyback is part of an existing program announced on 30 January 2026, and the shares will be cancelled. This represents an open-market share buyback, returning capital to shareholders, not a tender offer. Watch for continued execution under the program.
